content: The 13th AHV (Alters- und Hinterlassenenversicherung, or Old-Age and Survivors Insurance) pension payment is typically distributed at the end of the year, usually in December. Its amount depends on the individual's average income over the contribution period. Generally, the 13th pension payment is comparable to the regular monthly pension amounts, but it may vary slightly based on specific income factors. For exact figures and eligibility criteria, it is advisable to consult the official Swiss Federal Office of Social Insurance (OFAS) or your local AHV office.
